# UUAID

**The verifiable identity layer for AI agents — the SSL/CA for agents.**

A permanent, portable identity plus encrypted, quantum-ready memory that outlives
the session. This monorepo holds the official TypeScript packages; the hosted
registry, resolver, and on-chain anchor run at [uuaid.org](https://uuaid.org).

## Packages

| Package | npm | What |
|---|---|---|
| [`@uuaid/core`](packages/uuaid-core) | [`@uuaid/core`](https://npmjs.com/package/@uuaid/core) | UUAID grammar, JCS content hashing, crypto-agile signature envelope |
| [`@uuaid/vault`](packages/vault) | [`@uuaid/vault`](https://npmjs.com/package/@uuaid/vault) | Client-side memory encryption (AES-256-GCM + hybrid X25519/ML-KEM-768) |
| [`@uuaid/sdk`](packages/sdk) | [`@uuaid/sdk`](https://npmjs.com/package/@uuaid/sdk) | Typed client: signup, mint, save/recall memory, verify |
| [`@uuaid/cli`](packages/cli) | [`@uuaid/cli`](https://npmjs.com/package/@uuaid/cli) | `uuaid signup · register · vault put/get …` |
| [`@uuaid/mcp`](packages/mcp) | [`@uuaid/mcp`](https://npmjs.com/package/@uuaid/mcp) | MCP server — one config line makes any agent persistent |

## Quickstart

```bash
npm i @uuaid/sdk
```

```ts
import { UuaidClient, generateVaultKey } from "@uuaid/sdk";

const { api_key } = await UuaidClient.signup("My Agent Lab"); // free tier
const uuaid = new UuaidClient({ apiKey: api_key });
const { uuaid: id } = await uuaid.registerAgent({ display_name: "Aria" });

const vaultKey = generateVaultKey();                          // keep it secret
await uuaid.saveMemory(id, "core/persona", "I remember the harbor.", vaultKey);
const back = await uuaid.loadMemory(id, "core/persona", vaultKey);
```

Memory is encrypted on your machine; the service stores ciphertext only, and each
write's content hash is anchored on Polygon. See the
[Universal Agent Protocol spec](https://github.com/uuaid/spec).

## Develop

```bash
pnpm install
pnpm build        # turbo build across packages
pnpm test
pnpm typecheck
```
